007 - The World Is Not Enough.name: James Bond 007: The World Is Not Enough
007 - The World Is Not Enough.summary: James Bond 007: The World Is Not Enough is based off of the 1999 James Bond film of the same name. In contrast to the Nintendo 64 and Playstation versions, this game only has eight missions and features a 2D overhead view instead of a 3D first-person. There is no multiplayer, no difficulty levels, and no save feature. Passwords are used to skip to later levels and unlock certain cheats.

Doraemon no Study Boy - Gakushuu Kanji G.name: Doraemon no Study Boy: Gakushuu Kanji Game
Doraemon no Study Boy - Gakushuu Kanji G.summary: Doraemon no Study Boy: Gakushuu Kanji Game is a Japanese Game Boy Color game.

Ojarumaru - Tsukiyo ga Ike no Takaramono.name: Ojarumaru: Tsukiyo ga Ike no Takaramono
Ojarumaru - Tsukiyo ga Ike no Takaramono.summary: A game of the popular NHK educational anime "Ojarumaru". There are 3 modes: "Tabi-dachi niru (single-player mode)", "Tokukun-itashimasu (mini-game mode)", and "Welcome to me (two-player battle mode)". Set in Moonlight Town, the game is played in a sugoroku format, collecting items placed in each square, playing against each other in a mini game, and more when one of them finishes at the pond. The one who collects the points of is the winner.
